reply.thought: I will verify the ledger via tools: list orders/refunds and check net balances per customer, ensuring Alpha’s reported refunds cover the batch before recording any payouts.
I will list refunds recorded on the shared ledger to confirm Alpha applied all refunds for this batch (orders 113,114,115) before paying net balances.
